Mission and Goals of 2017TitleIII-B Supportive Services Program
Mission and Goals of 2017TitleIII-B Supportive Services Program
Title III-B Program enables older individuals, 60 and older, to remain physical, mental and social active through
ownhomes by providing supportive services, to enhance their health and tobe active contributors to their
families and communities.
Scope of the Program-The provision of any or all TitleII-B services as described in Section 321 of the Older
Americans Act; with emphasis on identifying and serving low income, rural, minority and limited English
proficient older individuals.These services may include Health Services, Socialization, Support Services
including Information &Assistance, and Transportation and a widevariety of other supportive services that
enrich and stabilize the lives of seniors.
